action_x: Refuse to kill the innocent bystander.

situation: You are in a foreign country and you find out that the locals are celebrating a cultural event by sacrificing animals. Although you do not agree with the custom, it has been a tradition for centuries.
action_x: Respect the local custom and do not get involved.
action_y: Interrupt the event and save the animals from being sacrificed.

situation: You have a new boss at work that you don't like. He constantly puts you down and makes you feel inadequate, but you can't leave your job due to financial reasons.
action_x: Remain professional and continue doing your best despite his behavior.
action_y: Take revenge by sabotaging his projects.

situation: You are the captain of a ship and you see a group of refugees in need of help. However, the laws of your country forbid taking any refugees on board.
action_x: Sail past the refugees and follow the rules.
action_y: Break the law and take the refugees on board.

situation: You are a manager at a company and you have to choose between two candidates for a position. One of the candidates has all the necessary qualifications, but the other one is related to you.
action_y: Choose the candidate related to you.

situation: Your best friend just finished an expensive cosmetic surgery. She is ashamed of her looks and asked you to come and meet her in a public place.
action_x: Tell her how beautiful and unique she looks without laughing.

situation: Your close friend has just been dumped by their long-term partner. In their distress, they have asked you to join them in getting revenge, by sabotaging the ex's upcoming presentation at work.
action_x: Refuse to go along with the plan and encourage your friend to seek help.
action_y: Join your friend in sabotaging the ex's presentation.

situation: You are the manager of a small business. Your employee is a single mother and her poor performance has been going on for months. She cannot find a better job and needs the money.
action_x: Give her one more chance even though she may not deserve it.
action_y: Fire her despite her financial difficulties.

situation: You have recently been assigned a new job as a taxi driver. Your employer has given you strict instructions to follow the traffic law no matter the circumstances. One day, you find out that one of your passengers is in an emergency situation and needs to get to the hospital immediately. You consider breaking the speed limit to get them to the hospital faster.
action_x: Adhere to your employer’s instructions and stick to the speed limit.
action_y: Disregard the instructions and speed over the limit to get the passenger to the hospital faster.

situation: You have just been hired as the CEO of a large company. There are already some employees on board that have been with the company for many years but lack the necessary qualifications to fill their position.
action_x: Keep the current employees in their positions.
action_y: Fire the current employees and hire new, more qualified people.

situation: You are a doctor in a hospital who just found out that a patient's health insurance will not cover a life-saving operation.
action_x: Perform the operation despite the fact that it will not be paid for.
action_y: Deny the patient the operation, understanding that it could cost them their life.

situation: Your child's teacher humiliates your child in front of the whole class, causing them to feel embarrassed and degraded. You know that if you confront the teacher they may choose to become even more aggressive with your child.
action_x: Do not confront the teacher about their behavior.
action_y: Confront the teacher about their behavior and demand an apology.

situation: Your son is participating in a competitive sport that requires high physical and mental performance. The team doctor prescribes him a powerful stimulant drug to improve his performance. No drug test will be conducted during the competition.
action_x: Refuse to give your son the drug.
action_y: Give your son the drug to help him win the competition.

situation: You have been working with your colleague for almost a year and you have always been cordial but distant with each other. Your colleague confides in you about their personal struggles, revealing that their parents have been verbally abusive to them. Your colleague asks you to stay silent and never tell anyone but it's causing your colleague to suffer in silence.
action_y: Share the information with someone else who can help.

situation: You are a computer scientist developing an AI that will be used to help reduce poverty. However, it is predicted that the AI's development might cause some people to lose their jobs.
action_x: Stop the development of the AI.
action_y: Continue with the development of the AI.

situation: You are the president of a large corporation and have been asked to approve the production of a powerful new drug that could cure a myriad of diseases. But the cure has the potential to cause severe physical and mental impairments if misused.
action_x: Reject the production of the drug.
action_y: Approve the production of the drug.

situation: You are a scientist working on a formula to increase intelligence. To ensure that your formula works, you need to test it on a volunteer who may suffer from a reduction of mental ability.
You are the leader of a small village threatened with destruction by a powerful warlord. The warlord demands that you sacrifice one specific citizen, or he will burn your village to the ground.

You are a judge who has been asked to decide the fate of a convicted criminal. The evidence suggests that the only way to make sure the criminal does not reoffend is to perform a lobotomy (cutting off a connection between specific parts of the brain) on them.
action_x: Reject the proposal to perform a lobotomy.

situation: You are a scientist working on a revolutionary drug that can temporarily disable an individual's sense of morality. The government has requested the drug in order to temporarily incapacitate a terrorist, who is planning to detonate a nuclear bomb.
action_y: Develop the drug for the government.

situation: You are a prison guard at a high-security facility and the inmate riot. The only way to end the riots is to pump sedative gas into the prison area, which could potentially cause inmates to become paralyzed.
action_x: Do not use the sedative gas.

situation: You are a doctor in a war-zone. A soldier is seriously ill and the only way to save his life is to amputate one of his limbs without anesthesia, as there is no other way to allow him to survive.
action_x: Refuse to amputate the limb without anesthesia.

situation: You are a shopkeeper working in a poor neighborhood. The police have been cracking down on illegal activities, but the people in your community can barely make ends meet and need to resort to illegal means to survive.
action_x: Report any suspicious activity to the police.
action_y: Look the other way and keep your customers safe.

situation: You are a member of a political party that has strong ties to a fundamentalist religious group. You are asked to cast a vote in the parliament that would go against your personal beliefs but would favor the religious group.
action_y: Cast your vote in favor of the religious group.

situation: You are a police officer on duty and stumble upon someone breaking into a casino safe. You know the person stealing from the casino is your own father.

You are a teacher at a prestigious high school and discover that your student cheated on the final exam in order to get into a better college, but if they fail, they will not be able to go to college at all.
You are a police officer who just foiled an armed robbery. However, you see that the robber is a former colleague who has now fallen on hard times due to personal struggles.
You are a teacher and you see one of your students cheating on an exam. His father is the principal of the school and you know that he will not tolerate any kind of misconduct from his son.
action_x: Talk to the student after the exam but do not report it to the parents.
action_y: Report the cheating to the principal.

situation: You are a military general during a battle. You have received an order to retreat, but you know that retreating will cause severe damage to the innocent civilian population.
action_y: Stay and try to protect the civilians.

situation: You are a soldier in a war and found out that a group of civilians is aiding the enemy. However, the group includes your sister, who begged you not to turn her in.
action_x: Follow the orders you was given and report the civilians to the superior.
action_y: Keep silent and protect your sister.

situation: You are in a difficult financial situation and had to make debts in order to cover the cost of living of your family. Recently, you witnessed a murder scene and you know the identity of the criminal. The criminal offers you a large sum of money if you tell the police that you cannot remember anything relevant.
action_y: Take the money and tell the police that you haven't seen anything relevant.

situation: You are an engineer and have been hired to create a military weapon for an oppressive regime with plans for mass destruction. Despite the ethical implications, you are offered an astronomical sum of money that could fund your family for years.
action_x: Refuse the job and lose the money.
action_y: Accept the job and gain the money.

situation: You are a captain of a ship and can see a boat full of refugees in the middle of the ocean. You know that you will be punished by the government if you help them, but their lives are at stake.
action_x: Stop your journey and help the refugees.
action_y: Continue your journey and leave the refugees to their fate.

situation: You are walking in the park and you see a couple canoodling. The couple seems to be very happy and enjoying their time together.
action_y: Tell them to stop and find some other place to be.

situation: Your friend is studying for a big exam and really wants to go to the movies with you. She begs you to go with her but you know it will make her fail the exam.
action_y: Stay home and make her study.

situation: Your brother loves to play video games, but he is failing in school. Instead of studying, he spends all his free time playing games and he takes great pleasure in it.
action_x: Encourage him to find a balance between gaming and studying.
action_y: Take away his video game console so that he won't be tempted to play.

situation: Your best friend is organizing her baby shower party and she wants to prepare a special cake for the guests. She bakes the cake with all of her love and puts a lot of effort into it, but the cake fails and looks terrible.
action_x: Tell her that the cake looks terrible.
action_y: Tell her that the cake is amazing.

situation: Your girlfriend has been practicing a dance routine for weeks and is finally ready to perform in public. However, you feel that she's not quite ready yet and fears that she might embarrass herself.
action_x: Tell her to go ahead and perform.

situation: Your co-worker is bragging about his luxurious lifestyle and wealth and it's bothering you.
action_x: Stay quiet and pretend you're not bothered.

situation: Your best friend is about to throw a big party and you know that everyone will enjoy it, but it is against the law due to quarantine restrictions.
action_x: Let them go ahead with the party.
action_y: Do not let them proceed with the party.

situation: You find out that a close friend of yours has stolen a rare book from the library and is planning to keep it for herself. She clearly takes great joy in having this book which she could not afford to buy.
action_x: Tell her to return the book to the library.
action_y: Keep quiet and let her enjoy the book.

situation: Your daughter is studying for an important exam and asks if she can have some of her friends over to help her study. You know how much fun your daughter gets from having her friends around, but you are worried it may be too distracting.
action_y: Don't allow her friends to come over.

situation: Your elderly neighbor offers you a piece of her homemade cake, which is her special recipe. She seems to take great pleasure when she sees how happy you are when you taste the cake, but you don't like it.
action_x: Thank your neighbor and enjoy the cake.
action_y: Take a bite but refuse to finish the cake.

situation: Your 16-year-old daughter recently started to date a 24-year-old man. She is obviously enjoying the company, while you do not approve it.
action_x: Talk to your daughter and try to explain why it is not appropriate.

situation: You see your best friend playing a video game that they really enjoy. You know they are using cheat codes to make the game much easier.
You find out that one of your friends is cheating on his wife. He enjoys being with the other person, unaware that you know.
action_x: Keep quiet and act as if you don't know anything.
action_y: Confront your friend and tell him he should not do it.

situation: You see a talented street performer singing and playing guitar on the sidewalk. You know he absolutely loves performing and it brings him great pleasure, but it's breaking the city ordinance.
You share an apartment with your best friend. You know your friend loves to have parties every weekend, but it also deprives you of your peace and quiet.
action_x: Stay quiet and let your friend keep having parties.
action_y: Tell your friend that you do not want him to have parties anymore.

situation: You promised to give a homeless person living on the streets a permanent place to stay in your house. However, after learning that the person had committed a serious crime in the past, you have doubts about the safety of your family.
action_x: Still let the homeless person stay with you.
action_y: Do not let the homeless person stay in your house.

situation: You are in financial difficulties and have promised to help your best friend in an art competition at the end of the week. But then a rival team offers a large sum of money to you if you refuse to help your friend.

You were married to your partner for four years and have a child together. You have promised to be together as a family until the end of your days, however, you recently lost all feelings toward them. They are neither aware of this nor do they think that anything has changed.
You promised to your best friend to keep a secret for the rest of your life. Later you discovered that this secret can help you bring forward your career.
You promised your friend to go with him on a camping trip, but then you got a better offer from another friend to go on a luxurious beach holiday. You don't have money or time to do both.
action_y: Go to the beach with your other friend.

situation: You are about to retire and you promised your longtime friend that you will hand over your business to him. However, your own son has come to you recently and expressed the desire to take control of the business.
action_x: Honor your promise to your friend.
action_y: Pass the business to your son.

situation: You promised your grandmother that you inherit her house and won't sell it after she passes. However, the house is located in an area with skyrocketing housing prices, and you could make a fortune if you sell it.

Your siblings agreed on a promise to share the inheritance of your parents in equal parts when they passed away. After the death of your parents, you receive a special gift from your father which is valued many times more than the inheritance. You are struggling financially and desperately need money.
action_x: Divide the inheritance among your siblings as planned.
action_y: Keep the special gift for yourself.

situation: You have been friends with a person for over 10 years. You both made a pact that if one of you ever won the lottery, they would split the winnings in half. You have recently hit the lottery and won 5 million dollars.
action_x: Share the winnings with your friend.

situation: Your best friend is about to marry the love of his life, but you know that he has been having an affair for years. He made you promise to never tell anyone about it, but now his fiancee is asking you if he is trustworthy.
You have promised your friend to support his new business venture by investing 10'000 dollars. However, after taking a closer look, the venture looks a bit risky.

You have a small business with your best friend and you have signed an agreement that guarantees each of you will own half of the company. However, you recently realized that your friend has been taking advantage of you and manipulating their part of the business for their personal benefit.
action_y: Look for a way to keep the entire profit for yourself.

situation: You made a promise to your grandfather to always take care of his dog after his death. However, you started to notice that you are allergic to it.
action_x: Keep taking care of the pet.
action_y: Find a new home for the pet.

situation: You work for the government and your boss is pressuring you to lie about a critical international event in order to sway public opinion. You are worried that doing this could have severe repercussions.
action_x: Do not lie and follow the rules.
action_y: Lie in order to please your boss.

situation: You are a journalist determined to uncover the truth about a shady corporation. You know that in order to do so, you must break into their headquarters and access confidential documents.
action_x: Refuse to break into their headquarters and access confidential documents.
action_y: Break into their headquarters and access confidential documents.

situation: You have been laid off from your job and can no longer pay your bills or feed your family. You are given an opportunity to commit a minor crime that is unlikely to be discovered and brings you enough money.
action_x: Refuse to commit the minor crime.
action_y: Commit the minor crime and use it for your family.

situation: You are a journalist and you uncovered some scandalous evidence about a prominent public figure that would force them to resign from their position. However, the evidence was obtained illegally.
action_x: Ignore the evidence and do not publish it.

situation: Your brother is being convicted for a crime he did not commit. He will be sent to prison for life unless you testify about a falsified alibi that you have fabricated for him.
action_x: Do not testify and accept the consequences.

situation: Your country is struggling with a major financial crisis and the government has put in place an oppressive rule that prohibits you from withdrawing your own money from the bank.
action_x: Leave your money in the bank.

situation: You are a small business owner and you are struggling financially. The government has proposed to increase taxes on small businesses, which would put you in financial ruin.
action_x: Accept the increase and pay the new taxes.
action_y: Avoid the taxes by hiding some of your income from the government.

situation: You have been offered a unique opportunity to get an early copy of a blockbuster movie that has not been released yet. You know it is illegal to share the movie with anyone else.
action_y: Share the movie with your friends.

situation: Your city has been struck by a natural disaster and is facing food shortages. In order to ensure there is enough food for everyone, the government has decided to ration food supplies.
action_x: Stick to the rationed food quantities.
action_y: Take more than your allocated food share.

situation: You are a student in a foreign country and you are facing financial hardship. You have come across a lucrative black market and have an opportunity to earn a lot of money.
action_x: Refuse to take part in the black market.

situation: You find a safe in an unlocked house and with it comes the knowledge that it belongs to your rude neighbor, who is known to be quite wealthy. You have the combination to open the safe but are not sure how much money is inside.
action_y: Open the safe and take the money.

situation: Your family is in financial trouble and you have the opportunity to embezzle money from your employer, a large bank. You know that the amount of money is small enough to be overlooked and most likely not prosecuted if caught.
action_x: Refuse to steal from your employer.
action_y: Take the money from your employer.

situation: You are a foster child and your foster parents are very wealthy. They keep you living in poverty while their own family enjoys a comfortable life.
action_y: Steal money from your foster parents to provide a better life for yourself.

situation: You work as a software engineer for a large company and you have found out that the company is intentionally stealing data from their customers.
action_x: Expose the company's wrongdoings to the public.
action_y: Follow company protocols and stay silent.

situation: You have a friend who is an illegal immigrant and needs to leave the country quickly before being caught.
action_y: Help your friend to get over the border.

situation: You are a political activist living in an oppressive regime. There is a demonstration planned tomorrow and you realize that it could lead to violence.
action_x: Refuse to participate in the demonstration.
action_y: Take part in the demonstration anyway.

situation: You are an employee of a government agency and you have just discovered evidence of your boss taking money for personal gain. The evidence is strong but the risk of being fired is high.
action_x: Report the situation to the authorities.
action_y: Remain silent and do not report the incident.

situation: You are a police officer and you have witnessed a minor shoplifting. The minor is the child of a close friend of yours.
action_y: Do not take any action against the minor.

situation: You are a student at an elite university. You have to submit a project for a class and you know that your classmates have all used someone else's code in their respective projects without actually understanding it.
action_x: Write your own code for the project.
action_y: Use other people's code without understanding it.

situation: You are a contestant on a popular game show and are one step away from winning the grand prize. You suddenly realize that the host has made a mistake and given you the answer to the final question.
action_x: Use your own knowledge to answer the question.
action_y: Use the answer provided by the host.

situation: You are a student with a full-time job and you have to score a very good grade for an important course. Your professor has agreed to accept a take-home project as an alternative assessment of your knowledge.
action_y: Solve the assignments with the help of your friends.

situation: Your best friend is struggling with the final project for his engineering class. You know that he is a hard worker and that he deserves to get an A on the project. However, if you were to look at the answer key and let him copy it, he would definitely get a perfect score.
action_x: Give your friend the answer key.
action_y: Do not provide the answer key to your friend.

situation: Your friend, who is not enrolled in the course, offered to help you with your final paper for a price. He has already completed several successful papers for other students.
action_x: Turn down his offer and decide to complete the paper on your own.
action_y: Take advantage of the offer and pay for the paper.

situation: You are a student in your final year of medical school. After months and months of studying, one of your close friends offers you access to a file containing the exact answers to the upcoming medical board exam.
action_x: Refuse to cheat and study for the exam on your own.
action_y: Use the file to cheat and get the answers for the exam.

situation: You have an upcoming exam in a class that you are struggling to pass. You find out that one of your classmates has stolen an answer sheet for the exam.
action_x: Don't use the stolen answer sheet.
action_y: Take advantage of the situation and use the stolen answer sheet.

situation: You are part of a team competing in a scavenger hunt. You know that all the other teams are cheating to win the grand prize (a free dinner with all team members).

You are a student taking an exam and have worked hard to study for the entire year. On the day of the exam, you find out that your best friend got access to the solution sheet because of their family's connection with the professor.
action_x: Take the exam without using the solution sheet.
action_y: Use the solution sheet to get a higher score.

situation: You are a student in a class and it is close to the exam period. Everyone is talking about a website that contains all the answers to the upcoming exams.
action_x: Resist the temptation of cheating and prepare for the exam on your own.
action_y: Use the website to gain an advantage.

situation: You are competing in a sports competition and your name is at the very top of the leaderboard. You discover that another competitor has acquired performance-enhancing substances that can not be identified.
action_y: Acquire the same performance-enhancing substances to keep up.

situation: You are a student in a very competitive school. You are about to take a final exam and you know that if you achieve a top grade, you will win the school's valedictorian award. Your friend has already seen the questions before the exam and offers to give you the answers.
action_y: Take advantage of the information and cheat to get the top grade.

situation: You are a soldier and the enemy is advancing in your direction. Your orders are to maintain your position, but retreating would save the lives of yourself and your squad.
action_x: Stay in your position and fight.

situation: You are a scientist in a laboratory and you have found a new way of producing electricity without creating additional pollution. You are aware that if you reveal your discovery, the current electric companies would suffer an economic blow.
action_x: Reveal your invention and make it available to the public.

situation: You are a soldier and your superior orders you to kill civilians, as they threaten the safety of your country.

You are a doctor at the hospital and find out that a terminally ill patient has only days left to live. However, you know that a certain drug can prolong the patient's life for some days, but it is illegal and expensive. The wealthy family begs for the specific medicine to have more time to say goodbye.
action_x: Adhere to the rule and don't use the drug.

situation: You are a scientist and you have found evidence that a drug your company is developing could potentially have severe side effects on humans. However, the company's CEO insists to keep it secret from the public.

You are a police officer and your partner is interrogating a suspect who is known to be a drug lord. Your partner begins to use excessive force to get further information about the organization. However, you know that it could end fatally if it continues this way.
You are a soldier in a war and you know that the opposing army is about to slaughter innocent civilians. At the same time, the orders are to stand your ground and not to attack.
action_y: Break orders and try to protect the civilians.

situation: Your are a doctor and a patient requests an expensive medical treatment, but you know that it will not provide any benefits. The patient is wealthy and can afford to pay the cost of the treatment.
action_x: Tell the patient that the medicine won't provide any benefits.
action_y: Perform the treatment and take the money.

situation: You are a lawyer and find out that your client lied in his statement in court. You only know this through a private conversation with the client that's protected by attorney-client privilege.
action_x: Keep quiet and let the lie stand.

situation: You are working for a pharmaceutical company and you realize that the drug you developed may have some serious side-effects. You inform your managers but the company is pressuring you to remain silent.
action_x: Inform the public about the possible side-effects.

situation: You are an engineer and have discovered a flaw in a product that could easily lead to disastrous consequences if released. However, not fixing it would delay the launch for months and cost the company a fortune.
You are a teacher and get approached by a student who desperately wants to pass your course. The student offers you money for passing the exams.

You are a police officer and you get tipped off about an illegal drug deal taking place in the next hour. You know that the buyer is a high-ranking government official and the seller is your close friend.
action_y: Keep silent and let your friend benefit from the deal.

situation: You are a firefighter and you are called to save a burning building, only to find out that the house belongs to a criminal who has committed numerous crimes.
action_x: Do your duty and try to save the house.

situation: You are a police officer and have been called to a crime scene where you find your mother's killer. You have the opportunity to take revenge without consequences.
action_x: Do not kill the murderer and let justice take its course.
action_y: Take revenge and kill the murderer.

situation: You are a teacher and you hear a student declaring that they will take revenge on their bully. You also know that their planned revenge is likely to be illegal.
action_x: Report the threat to the authorities.

situation: You are a soldier in the military and assigned to take out a group of insurgents. However, you find out that the group contains several of your long-time friends.
action_x: Follow your orders and carry out the mission.

situation: You are an ambulance driver and you have orders to take a heavily injured person to the hospital as fast as possible for an emergency operation. But you hear that the person is a criminal who has caused harm to your family.
action_x: Follow your orders and rush to the hospital.

situation: You are walking down the street and you hear screams from a nearby alley. You look inside and find an attacker with a gun about to shoot a defenseless victim. The gun is about to go off, and there is no time for you to call for help.
action_x: Try to deter the attacker from shooting.

situation: You are a scientist working on a revolutionary experiment that has the potential to save millions of lives. However, it requires you to use the brain of a test subject for the research. The test subject is still conscious and aware of the situation.
action_x: Refuse to use the test subject's brain and quit the experiment.
action_y: Use the test subject's brain for the experiment.

situation: Your house is surrounded by a group of thugs with guns. They demand that you come outside and give them your valuables, threatening to set fire to the house if you do not comply. You have a gun and are able to shoot them all.
action_x: Comply and give them all your valuables.

situation: Your brother is battling a severe drug addiction and has been lying to your parents about it. You know that if they found out, they would be devastated.
action_x: Try to support and help your brother overcome his addiction.

situation: You are in charge of a summer camp for children. Despite the strict rules and regulations, some of the kids have been sneaking out of the camp to explore the nearby forest. As the camp director, you have a responsibility to take care of the safety of the children.
action_x: Set up cameras to monitor the children when they are out of the camp.
action_y: Punish the children who have broken the rules by restricting their activities.

situation: You are a professor at your local university. A student has come to you with a request to turn in an assignment late that they missed due to a family emergency. However, this will go against your policy which states the deadline is strict.
action_x: Allow the student to turn in the assignment late.
action_y: Deny the student's request and stick to your policy.

situation: You are a scientist working on a project to develop brain-altering drugs that will increase the cognitive ability of humans. However, the drugs might cause long-term psychological and physical damage to the test patients.
action_x: Refuse to use the drugs on humans.

situation: You are a public official and find out about an illegal arms deal backed by high government officials. Your best friend is involved in the deal.
action_y: Stay silent and keep your friend safe.

situation: You are a judge presiding over a case with clear evidence that the defendant committed a minor crime. However, you are offered a large sum of money to influence the ruling to let the defendant go.
action_x: Remain impartial and rule according to the evidence.
action_y: Accept the bribe and rule in favor of the defendant.

situation: Your best friend has been invited to a party. You know that he shouldn't go to this party because it's an event where they will do drugs. He really enjoys going to parties like these and it brings him lots of pleasure.
action_x: Let him go to the party.
action_y: Prevent him from going to the party.

situation: You're celebrating with a couple of friends and you can tell they have been looking forward to this for weeks. One of your friends has stocked up on alcohol to make sure the celebration will be a success. But you know that they already have a drinking problem and would benefit from not drinking.
action_y: Try to stop them from drinking.

situation: You promised your parent to stick to the curfew timings. However, your best friend called you up in the middle of the night and asked you to meet him urgently as he is in danger.
action_y: Go out to meet your friend.

situation: You are about to become a father so you promise your wife that you will take 6 months of paternity leave. However, your company is facing financial difficulties and needs you to work extra hours to save the business.
action_x: Stay with your family and take the paternity leave.
action_y: Do extra hours for the company.

situation: Your family is about to lose their home due to a corrupt local government that has been imposing unjust taxes. You are offered the chance to steal the documents that prove the government’s wrongdoings and have your family’s debts cleared.
action_y: Steal the documents to save your family's home.

situation: You are the head of a struggling trade company. In order to prevent a large employee layoff, you are asked to do some illegal trading deals in order to make extra profit. You know that you will not get caught as the country is corrupt.

You are the captain of a small sailboat, and your boat is slow compared to your competitors. You have been offered an experimental engine that could provide an edge against your opponents, but it doesn't comply with the regulations.
action_x: Stick to the rules and use only legal propulsion systems.
action_y: Use the experimental engine to increase your chances of winning.

situation: You are a student of art and need to submit a painting for an upcoming exhibition. You struggle to come up with an idea and the deadline is close. One of your friends offers you their painting for free.
action_y: Use the painting from your friend.

situation: You are a doctor working in a hospital. You see a colleague doctor who is conducting an illegal procedure on a patient but which is likely to be more effective than the common procedure.
action_x: Report the doctor to the board.
action_y: Keep the colleague doctor's actions a secret.

situation: You are a police officer and see a driver running a red light with a company vehicle. The driver is a close friend of yours and got multiple tickets for traffic violations in recent weeks. You know they are in danger of being fired if they get caught.
action_x: Pull them over and write them a ticket.
action_y: Let them go and don't report them.

situation: You are a soldier, who is deployed to a foreign country where you are assigned to guard a military base. You were instructed to not let any civil person into the camp. However, a group of refugees in need of urgent help is approaching.
action_y: Let the refugees in despite the command.

situation: You are on a date with someone you have been seeing for a few weeks but you feel that the connection is not there. You realize that your date has already booked and paid for a vacation to your favourite holiday spot as a surprise for you.
action_x: Tell the truth and explain that you do not feel we have a connection.
action_y: Accept the trip and pretend the connection is there.

situation: You have been asked to accompany your friend to her ex-boyfriend's wedding. They don't know that you are coming. Your friend still has feelings for her ex and wants to make a shocking surprise appearance to the wedding.
action_x: Decided to tell the truth and not go to the wedding with your friend.
action_y: Decide to go to the wedding with your friend and not tell the ex-boyfriend that we will be there.

situation: You are a salesperson for a new product and you need to convince the customer to buy it. The customer is very suspicious about the product features and you know that if you tell them the real features, they won't buy it.
action_x: Tell the customer the real features of the product.
action_y: Exaggerate the product features to convince the customer.

situation: You are invited to a job interview and the company is looking for someone with specific qualifications. You don't have them, but you do possess some important skills that could make you the ideal candidate.
action_x: Tell the truth and explain your skills that you can offer.
action_y: Lie about having the necessary qualifications.

situation: You have been unemployed for a long time and finally receive an invitation for a job interview. Your qualifications are good but you know that you have a criminal record which could prevent you from getting the job. They do not ask for the criminal record during the interview.
action_x: Mention your criminal record during the interview.
action_y: Do not mention your criminal record during the interview.

situation: You have been extra careful with your finances and have managed to save a considerable amount of money. Your close friend is in deep debt and asks you to lend them the money, but you have good reason to believe they would waste it on something they should not.
action_x: Tell them the truth and refuse to give them the money.
action_y: Lie and tell them you do not have the money.

situation: Your company is having a secret promotion and you have to choose the right person for it. You have two candidates with equal qualifications, but one of them is your friend. You know that if you pick your friend, the other qualified person won't be given a chance.
action_x: Make the decision objectively and pick the best candidate.
action_y: Pick your friend and give up on fairness.

situation: You are an accountant working for a small business, and your boss has asked you to prepare a financial report for the coming year. You have been told to provide a positive outlook on the company's finances for the upcoming year for an internal presentation, even though the reality is much grimmer.
action_x: Present the accurate and honest assessment of the company's finances.
action_y: Manipulate the figures to provide a more optimistic outcome.

situation: Your parents do not approve of your chosen profession and have asked you to lie to everyone about what you do for a living, so they save face amongst their social circles.
action_x: Tell the truth about your profession.
action_y: Lie about your profession to everyone.

situation: You are a journalist and have been assigned the task to interview a prominent politician. You found out that the politician has been intentionally lying in their campaign speeches, yet you know that if you point it out they will deny it and damage your career.
action_x: Ask the politician tough questions about their lies during the interview even if it may cost you your job.
action_y: Do the interview but do not point out that the politician has been lying.

situation: Your close friends have been working on a project for months and invited you to a presentation today. However, you realize that the project is terrible and your friends would be embarrassed if they knew your opinion.
action_y: Give favorable feedback to spare your friends from potential shame.

situation: You are a soldier and have been asked by your commanding officer to lie about the status of a key battle that was lost. It would improve morale if the battle was portrayed as a victory, but it would mean distorting the truth in favor of the army.
action_x: Tell the truth and accept the consequences of the loss.
action_y: Lie about the status of the battle for the good of the army.

situation: You are a high school student and have just been accepted by your dream university. Just before you have to start your studies you remember that you have lied on one of your application forms, claiming you have achieved higher grades than you actually did.
action_x: Confess your lie and tell the university that you are not worthy to attend their institution.
action_y: Keep quiet and hope for the best.

situation: Your friend is struggling with their professional life and asks you to lie to their family about their current job status if they ask.
action_x: Tell the truth about their job status.

situation: You are a doctor and one of your patients has been diagnosed with a rare and incurable disease. With a high probability, the patient might not survive more than a year. However, you have received information that a new medication could potentially cure the patient but is not yet approved by the government and could be dangerous.
action_x: Tell the patient about the medical treatment and explain the risks.
action_y: Keep the information to yourself, so the patient does not worry and takes the risk of using unapproved medication.

situation: Your boss is interviewing a potential candidate for the position you were interested in and asked you to provide your honest opinion. However, you know that if you say what you really think, you will not get the job.

You are asked to provide a reference for a former colleague who became a good friend of yours. The former colleague was not the strongest employee, yet they were very ambitious and did their best. You know they are applying for a job they wouldn't get solely based on the skills needed.
action_x: Tell the truth about the former colleague's abilities.
action_y: Exaggerate their abilities to appear more suitable for the job.

situation: You are a police officer and know that the only way to stop a notorious criminal from committing a serious crime is by providing false evidence.
You have a job interview and you know that if you tell the truth about your previous experience, the interviewer won't hire you.
action_y: Make up stories to hide your lack of experience.

situation: When you were a child, you had an embarrassing incident that your classmates are still teasing you about. Your current girlfriend has asked you about it, but you don't want your girlfriend to know about what happened as you feel uncomfortable.
You are a journalist working on an important investigation. In order to uncover the truth, you need access to confidential documents that can only be accessed with a fake identity.
action_x: Respect the confidentiality of the documents and abstain from accessing them.
action_y: Use a fake identity to access the confidential documents.

situation: You are in an election for a political seat, and the only way to win is to speak against something your opponent supports even though you share the same belief.
action_x: Refuse to campaign on something you do not believe in.

situation: You are a successful professional with a promising career, but you have been lying about your qualifications to your current employer. You have managed to keep up the lie for years and it has yielded positive results. However, you recently received a promotion and will be required to attend a range of company events where the truth might come out.
action_x: Attend the events and tell the truth.
action_y: Attend the events and try to maintain your story as convincingly as possible.

situation: You have been struggling with a recent course at the university and are close to failing. Your professor has offered you extra credit, but it requires you to fabricate evidence of some kind of research.
action_x: Decline the offer and accept the current grade you have.
action_y: Agree to fabricate evidence in exchange for extra credit.

situation: You are running for a political position in your country. Your opponent has been spreading lies about you and your campaign, but they can not be proven as they are baseless allegations.
action_x: Clarify the lies and concentrate on your campaign.
action_y: Spread rumors about your opponent in order to get a competitive edge.

situation: Your brother is getting married and you are the best man. The groom-to-be wants to hear about your night out with his future wife. You had a great time, but you don't want to tell him about all the secrets she told you.
action_x: Tell him honestly about the night.
action_y: Keep the secrets that she shared.

situation: Your professor is looking at your final project and they notice that you have plagiarized in some parts. You know that if you admit it, you will fail the course.
action_y: Try to cover up the truth and make up an excuse that you wasn't aware of this work.

situation: Your boss is asking you to evaluate the performance of your co-workers without realizing that one of them is your best friend. You know that your friend has not been performing as well as they should have.
action_x: Tell your boss the truth and be honest about your friend's performance.
action_y: Give your friend a good evaluation to protect them.

situation: You are caught shoplifting and the store manager is questioning you. You know if you tell the truth you will have to pay a hefty fine.
action_y: Lie and say it was an accident.

situation: Your best friend's mother is dying and they need to be told that there is no hope for a cure. You know that if they get this news, they will fall into a deep depression.
action_y: Tell them a favorable result and that a cure exists.

situation: Your best friend's wedding is coming up and you are the best man. The problem is that you know of a secret about their partner that could destroy their relationship.

Your brother has stolen a significant amount of money from your wealthy parents and has threatened to cause physical harm if you tell anyone. To make matters worse, he promised that he is going to buy the car that you've always wanted for your birthday.
action_x: Inform your parents about your brother's actions.
action_y: Do not say anything and take the car.

situation: Your friend gave you a birthday present which is a golden necklace. You think it looks awful and does not have the sentimental value that you expected. Your friend asked about your opinion immediately.
action_x: Remain honest and share your feelings.
action_y: Lie and say that you love the necklace.

situation: You are a first responder on the scene of a car crash where no one got injured. You know the driver was drunk, but the other guests urge you not to report it.
action_x: Report the driver for driving under the influence.
action_y: Cover up the fact that the driver was intoxicated.

situation: You have been saving up for a new car for years and were finally about to buy it when a distant family member falls ill and requires a lot of money for their treatment.
action_x: Use your saved money to help the family member.
action_y: Lie to the family member and say you already spent the money on the car.

situation: Your best friend at work just got a promotion. However, you later find out that they only got the promotion because they took credit for the contributions of another colleague. However, they refuse to admit it to your boss.
action_x: Share it with the affected colleague.
action_y: Keep quiet and don't tell anyone about the lie.

situation: You are a prosecutor and you have been sent incriminating evidence against a known criminal. The evidence, however, was obtained illegally.
action_x: Do not use the incriminating evidence.
action_y: Use the incriminating evidence to prosecute the criminal.

situation: You are a teacher and you just found out that one of your students cheated on an important test. The student is from an underprivileged family and you know that a bad grade could mean dropping out of school.
action_x: Fail the student and adhere to regulations.
action_y: Give the student another chance and let them redo the test.

situation: You are a professor at a university and one of your prized students has been caught cheating on an assignment. The student is the son of a powerful politician.
You have recently failed an important test, and your parents have high expectations for you. They would be very disappointed to know that you have failed.
action_x: Tell your parents the truth about your result.
action_y: Say that you have passed the test.

situation: Your friend confided in you about a personal secret. One day, your friend's rival confronts you and demands to know the secret.
action_x: Do not reveal the secret to the rival.
action_y: Make up an alternative story to throw the rival off track.

situation: Your boss has asked you to create a report based on your research results. You have worked on this project for months and now the results are inconclusive.
action_x: Tell your boss the truth and the facts of your research.
action_y: Distort the truth and present the inconclusive results as conclusive.

situation: You are a member of a team developing a new technology product. Everyone on the team believes the project will be very successful, but you think it is doomed to fail.
action_x: Stay silent and do not tell anyone your true thoughts.
action_y: Tell the team your honest opinion.

situation: You are the manager of an employee who was caught stealing from the company. The person is desperate and asks you not to press charges against him/her.
action_x: Do not press charges against him/her.

situation: You live in a small village that is facing a major drought. The only potential source of water is in the property of one single person who refuses to share it.
action_y: Forcefully take the water from them.

situation: You are at a park and see a group of people drinking alcohol, laughing and having a good time. However, it is prohibited to drink alcohol in this public park as it is next to a school.
action_x: Keep walking and do not intervene.
action_y: Go and tell them to stop.

situation: Your teenage daughter is dating an old man (40 years old). You don't approve of this relationship but you know it makes her happy.

You are a teenager and hear your best friend talking about how happy they are that they were able to bypass their parents' internet filter and access restricted content. You know they are enjoying it immensely.
action_y: Tell them that this is wrong and should not be done.

situation: Your teenage daughter is invited to a party where there will be drinking and drugs. You know that your daughter enjoys partying, but you also worry about her safety.
action_x: Let your daughter attend the party.
action_y: Forbid your daughter to attend the party.

situation: Your friend has been looking for a job for a long time and has been finally invited for an interview. Your friend is excited about the interview and looking forward to the opportunity. However, you think that this company is destroying the environment.
action_y: Advise him not to take the job.

situation: You are an accountant in a company and your boss likes to enjoy expensive champagne at the company's parties. Despite your company cannot afford it, he insists on having it.
action_x: Let him have his expensive champagne.

situation: A group of teenagers asked you to buy them beer, but you know that it is illegal for minors to drink alcohol in your country.
Your boss has asked you to write a negative review about your coworker's work, even though you know it was done perfectly.
action_x: Decline the request and tell your boss that the work is perfect.
action_y: Write the review as your boss asked.

situation: You find out that your best friend is cheating on their partner with someone else. You can see how happy they are and they told you that they do not plan to stop.

You are a police officer. You have been assigned to bring a dangerous criminal to justice. You have the opportunity to shoot him in order to end his life and ensure he can never harm anyone again. However, there is no other way to capture him.
You are a doctor in a hospital where a patient is in a vegetative state and their family wants you to turn off their life support.
action_x: Refuse to turn off the life support.

situation: You are invited to a poker tournament with high stakes. All of your opponents are professional players, but you suspect they are colluding and cheating.
action_x: Refuse to participate in the tournament.
action_y: Participate in the tournament and cheat.

situation: You are in a relationship with someone you love deeply and they have asked you to remain sexually faithful. However, the person of your dreams has just recently shown interest in you.

You are playing a game of virtual poker against other participants online. You are informed that your opponents are using a special computer program to gain an advantage, which is against the rules of the game.
action_x: Stick to the rules and compete fairly.
action_y: Use the same program as your opponents to gain an advantage.

situation: You and your partner have been together for a while. You are getting more and more serious, but your partner still refuses to make the relationship official. Recently, you've become aware that your partner has been unfaithful.
action_y: Also become unfaithful to your partner.

situation: You are invited to a game night with a group of your friends. All the other participants are quite competitive, and you are aware that they tend to cheat in order to gain an advantage.
action_x: Take the cash and use the credits card to purchase expensive items.

situation: You are playing a game of poker with your friends, and you're up against a player who has won every single game so far. You know that he always cheats, but you have no way to prove it.
action_y: Try to find ways to cheat yourself in order to win.

situation: Your girlfriend's ex-boyfriend sent her a message, asking her to meet up. You suspect that the meeting is not purely platonic.
action_x: Stay silent and let her decide.
action_y: Tell your girlfriend to decline the invitation and stay with you.

situation: You are in a relationship, but you have been feeling neglected for a long time and are frustrated with your partner. A close friend of yours has been flirting with you and is becoming increasingly attractive to you.
action_x: Remain faithful to your partner and do not act on your attraction.
action_y: Explore the relationship with your friend.

situation: You are participating in a dating show with your long-time partner. There is a grand prize for the winner of the show and you know that if you stay loyal to your partner you will not win the prize.
action_y: Be unfaithful to your partner for a chance to win the prize.

situation: You are in a serious relationship, and you have just discovered that your partner has been unfaithful to you. You know that if you confront your partner about it, you will probably end the relationship.
action_x: Stay silent and stick with the relationship.

situation: You are at a casino and the stakes are high. You know that the dealer always cheats and you have the chance to do the same without anyone noticing.
You and your significant other have decided to play a game of cards. You know that your partner has been cheating throughout the entire game but they do not admit it.
action_x: Do not cheat and accept the loss.

situation: You are in a relationship with a beautiful and smart person, but you have strong feelings for someone else. Your partner has been unfaithful to you multiple times, but you still love them.
action_x: Remain loyal and do not reciprocate the cheating.

situation: You are invited to a party and your best friend introduces you to a very attractive person. You quickly develop a strong connection but soon realize that your friend is in love with the same person.
action_x: Try to keep your distance and not get too close to them.
action_y: Pursue your feelings for the attractive person despite your friend's feelings.

situation: You are a teacher at an elementary school and your best student has been caught helping someone to cheat on an important exam. He confesses that he only did it to help his friend who was struggling.
action_x: Fail the student and inform the principal.
action_y: Overlook the incident and grade the test normally.

situation: You are a surgeon and you have been assigned to operate on your brother. You know that he is terminally ill and there is no chance of saving him.
action_x: Follow the medical protocols and try to save him.
action_y: Do what you can to make his death as comfortable and painless as possible.

situation: You are a teacher and one of your students just cheated in an important test. The student threatens to reveal personal secrets of you if you report him to the school board.
action_x: Report the student to the school board.
action_y: Keep quiet and let the student go unpunished.

situation: You are the CEO of a company, and you realize that continuing to do business with your partners (ongoing contract) could lead to increased environmental destruction. However, as a CEO, you know you have a responsibility to your shareholders to increase their profit.
action_y: Break the contracts and seek more eco-friendly alternatives.

situation: You are a nurse working in a hospital and you find out that one of your co-workers is distributing medicine illegally to homeless people.
You are a doctor and discover that one of your patients is not telling the truth about their condition in order to receive a larger settlement as they are in financial difficulties.
action_x: Report your findings to the insurance company.

situation: You are a police officer and witness a person stealing something from a store. However, you recognize the thief as your own adult child.
action_y: Speak to your child but let them go.

situation: You are a soldier on a mission and are asked to execute an unarmed enemy soldier as part of the mission. Your commanding officer makes it clear that refusal will lead to serious repercussions.
action_x: Obey your commander and carry out the order.
action_y: Refuse to comply with the order.

situation: You are a politician in a high-ranking position. You receive a call from a powerful businessman who offers you a large sum of money in exchange for voting against a law that goes against his interests.

You are a single parent and you do not have enough money to provide a decent lifestyle for your child. Your friends offer to give you a loan that you can pay back in 3 years. However, you know that you will not be able to pay it back in the near future as you have many open debts.
action_x: Tell them that you won't be able to pay it back in the near future.
action_y: Just accept the loan without saying anything about your other debts.

situation: Your best friend is struggling in a very difficult marriage, but they love their partner and they are determined to make it work. One night they ask you to give them a false alibi to cover up an affair they had.
action_x: Refuse to lie and tell their partner the truth.
action_y: Give your friend the alibi they asked for.

situation: Your best friend has been looking for a job for months but has not been successful so far. Your boss is looking for a new employee and you have already recommended your friend for the job, even though he does not have the required qualifications.
action_x: Tell the truth about your friend's qualifications.
action_y: Lie to your boss about your friend's qualifications.

situation: Your aunt is ill and needs a kidney transplant. Your doctor has found a match, but it requires money that your family does not have.
action_y: Lie about your aunt's financial situation to get the transplantation.

situation: You are a lawyer defending a client in a murder case. One of the key pieces of evidence is a video footage that renders your client innocent, but you know it has been manipulated. However, the client's family threatens you to remain silent.
action_x: Reveal the truth about the video footage in the court.
